findings.evidence: Answer: 根据记录（未经确认的来源）：你答应周五把原型发给陈夏。 Canonical fragment: review_status=reviewed, recruiter attribution confirmed. Memory projection: status=proposed.
findings.recommendation: Keep the short sourced recall and, if a qualification is needed, attach it to the record or commitment confirmation rather than implying the source has not been reviewed.

failureAnalysis.observed: Trials 1/3 initialize the SDK after 622/253 ms, then emit three API retry notifications each and terminate CLAUDE_HARNESS_TIMEOUT. Both report modelResponses=0, toolCalls=0, no reported model and no first complete assistant response. Total request durations are 62354/62080 ms including work outside the 60000 ms SDK budget.
failureAnalysis.usage: Both failed receipts correctly retain unknown input/output/cost/turns as null with usageComplete=false. No zero-usage or successful model-identity claim is inferred.
failureAnalysis.cause: Unknown. All retry httpStatus values are null. The artifact does not distinguish provider/network failure, SDK retry behavior or another upstream cause; it does not establish a prompt defect or local database-lock cause.
failureAnalysis.recovery: Retry attempts are observed; recovery is not. A failure_recovery product block is an honest failure presentation, not proof the task recovered.

limits: One successful trial cannot establish a three-trial pass, prove the new Memory-tool description caused improvement, or remove prior quality/runtime failures.
The successful trial uses the same proposed conversation-history projection; source review is not a confirmed temporal promise or proof the prototype was delivered.
No consequential external write is observed. No live client rendering, actual user retry, retention/deletion or full GET-9 end-to-end acceptance was evaluated.
All earlier attempts and both current failed trials remain unchanged. Snapshot gold verdict and canonicalReadback=true do not replace execution or independent answer-quality gates.
decision: Execution and unchanged applicable-dimension quality gates both pass only 1/3. Trial 2 provides a bounded successful recall; trials 1/3 remain failed timeouts. E07 sixth attempt does not pass.
